outcome: imaging characteristics and thickness of TP
cohort: 194 neonates who underwent brain MRI within the first 2 weeks of life.
finding: Torcular pseudomass (TP) is frequently observed in early newborns, is not associated with factors related to delivery, and typically resolves completely in most cases, suggesting it is of no clinical importance.
mod_finding: No association was found between torcular pseudomass and delivery type, fetal presentation during delivery, or birth difficulty.
followup_time: Up to one week for resolution of torcular pseudomass in a subset of patients.
cross-section timing: MRIs obtained within the first 2 weeks of life.
